name: Reliance Jamnagar Hyperscale AI Data Centre (reported world's largest)
notes: Bloomberg-reported (24 Jan 2025) plan by Reliance Industries to build a world's largest data centre at Jamnagar with a reported $20-30bn investment and multi-gigawatt scale powered by green energy (solar/wind/hydrogen); Baxtel lists it as a planned future facility (land bank secured) expected to house Nvidia GB200 systems. Official capacity MW not disclosed; listed as separate from the later RIL-Meta 168MW deal.

name: Reliance-Meta AI-Enabled Data Centre (168 MW)
developer: Reliance Industries Limited (built-to-suit lease to Meta Platforms)
notes: RIL announced (10 Jun 2026, joint statement with Meta) an AI-enabled data centre of 168 MW at its Jamnagar industrial campus in Gujarat, to be delivered within two years with an option to scale; Meta will lease the capacity - its first built-to-suit data centre capacity in India. Powered by renewable energy and cooled with desalinated seawater per company statements.
